name: nexus-dotnet
description: Nexus .NET (thin) — a stack extension for the `nexus` core pipeline. Ships the 37 .NET / ASP.NET Core / EF Core / CQRS / DDD / FastEndpoints code-pattern skills (including the mine-verify-cover and diagnose .NET adapters) plus the stack convention files (Read-Index model).
